# epiPot

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The `epiPot` package provides tools for analyzing the **epi**genetic **pot**ential of cells in single-cell data.


## Installation

Install the package from GitHub, e.g.

```{r}
remotes::install_github("csbg/epipot_package")
pak::pkg_install("csbg/epipot_package")
renv::install("csbg/epipot_package")
```

## Basic usage

see [this vignette](https://csbg.github.io/epipot_package/articles/epipot.html)
